description: A small discrete round mound about 8 m across and about 0.9 m high in a conifer plantation on flat ground crossed by fine parallel furrows. Several similar small round highs lie within about 100 m, including a ring-shaped mound with a central hollow about 35 m to the south. No modern object is visible at the point in five aerial flights from 2014 to 2025. No registered burial mound lies within 300 m.
alt_question: Could this small mound and its neighbours be natural sand hummocks, like the uneven ground to the south-west, or heaps left from clearing or planting, rather than a group of burial mounds?

facts.statement: Several small round highs within about 100 m of the point

limitations: No Messtischblatt (no georeferenced sheet covers the point); only one DGM1 delivery (no epoch comparison); ground hidden under plantation canopy in all DOP frames; mound is small and low.
